info.title: StaffGlimpse API
info.description: StaffGlimpse is a multi-tenant HR and Payroll SaaS platform. This OpenAPI 3.0 specification covers all REST endpoints for Company, User, Metadata, Messaging, Attendance, Document, and Leave management.

tags.name: Attendance
